episodes.title: Stavros Halkias Was Forced to Get Political: ‘I Hate It!’
episodes.description:
Comedian Stavros Halkias sat down with Joe and Jon to talk about the state of modern comedy, including how wealth and fame are impacting A-list comedians and why the rightward creep of his peers’ podcasts have “forced” him to get political. The interview also covers how Halkias’ weight has influenced his comedy, as well as his role in the Anthony Bourdain biopic “Tony” and his Netflix stand-up special “Uncle Stav.”

episodes.title: Stavros Halkias – Live at the Lodge Room (Stand-Up Comedy)
episodes.description:
In Live at the Lodge Room, Stavros Halkias delivers an explosive, crowd-driven stand-up set packed with fearless crowd work, brutal honesty, and nonstop laughs. Recorded in the intimate setting of the Lodge Room, Stavros feeds off the room’s energy, turning quick interactions and off-the-cuff moments into absolute comedy chaos.

This episode captures Stavros at his best—unfiltered, confident, and wildly unpredictable. His ability to riff in real time, push boundaries, and still keep the audience on his side makes this performance hit hard from start to finish. If you love raw stand-up, legendary crowd work, and comedy that feels alive in the moment, Live at the Lodge Room is a must-listen.

episodes.title: True Grit with Stavros Halkias
episodes.description:
We love to pull the cork. Comedian (and probably the biggest Greek-American entertainer of our time) Stavros Halkias joins us to chat about 2010’s True Grit, the Coens’ true attempt to cash their post-Oscar blank check. We’re talking about Hailee Steinfeld’s incredible performance. We’re talking about Jeff Bridges’ distinctive mumbly delivery. We’re talking about how this film is a considerable upgrade over the John Wayne original in possibly every way. We’re also talking about how everyone probably smells awful in this movie. And we’re talking a lot about the Morris Chestnut network TV show “Watson” for some reason. Join us by the campfire, it’s a fun time!
